vitality.definition: The capacity to live and develop.

voices.definition: Form of voice (plural): Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character.

voyage.definition: A long journey, especially by ship.

wail.definition: To cry out, as in sorrow or anguish.

waist.definition: The part of the body between the pelvis and the stomach.

warning.definition: Form of warn (participle present): To make (someone) aware of (something impending); especially.
